effect_catalog:
EFFECT / TECHNIQUE CATALOG (by category → harness map)

════════════════════════════════════════
ADJUST (techniques-adjust.md)
════════════════════════════════════════
- brightness: filter add brightness --layer N --param factor=F
- contrast: filter add contrast --layer N --param factor=F
- saturation: filter add saturation --layer N --param factor=F
- sharpness / unsharp_mask: filter add unsharp_mask --layer N --param radius=R --param percent=P --param threshold=T
- autocontrast: filter add autocontrast --layer N --param cutoff=0
- equalize: filter add equalize --layer N
- grayscale: filter add grayscale --layer N
- sepia: filter add sepia --layer N --param intensity=1.0
- posterize: filter add posterize --layer N --param bits=N
- solarize: filter add solarize --layer N
- invert: filter add invert --layer N
- gaussian_blur: filter add gaussian_blur --layer N --param radius=R
- box_blur: filter add box_blur --layer N
- find_edges: filter add find_edges --layer N
- emboss: filter add emboss --layer N
- contour: filter add contour --layer N
- detail: filter add detail --layer N
- smooth: filter add smooth --layer N
- rotate: filter add rotate --layer N --param angle=D --param expand=0
- flip_h / flip_v: filter add flip_h --layer N
- crop: filter add crop --layer N --param left= --param top= --param right= --param bottom=
- resize: filter add resize --layer N --param width=W --param height=H --param resample=lanczos
- Pillow pre-pass: ImageEnhance.Contrast/Color/Brightness/Sharpness for curves, color temperature, vignette not in harness

════════════════════════════════════════
BLEND (techniques-blend.md)
════════════════════════════════════════
- multiply: layer set N mode multiply (darkens; white vanishes)
- screen: layer set N mode screen (lightens; black vanishes)
- overlay: layer set N mode overlay (contrast punch)
- soft_light: layer set N mode soft_light (gentle grade)
- hard_light: layer set N mode hard_light (graphic poster hit)
- darken / lighten: layer set N mode darken|lighten (per-pixel min/max)
- difference: layer set N mode difference (frame alignment)
- color_dodge / color_burn: layer set N mode color_dodge|color_burn (neon/grit)
- addition / subtract: layer set N mode addition|subtract (linear effects)
- grain_merge / grain_extract: layer set N mode grain_merge|grain_extract (texture plates)
- opacity: layer set N opacity 0.0-1.0
- No per-channel blend, no blend-if sliders

════════════════════════════════════════
COMPOSITE (techniques-composite.md)
════════════════════════════════════════
- Multi-layer stack: layer add-from-file PATH (top index=0 after add)
- Offset placement: layer set N offset_x V / offset_y V (negative clips)
- Whole-layer fade: layer set N opacity F
- Grade guest to match host: filter add brightness|contrast|saturation on guest layer
- Seam hide: draw rect panel on overlay, or pre-cut PNG alpha in Pillow
- Hard-crop guest: filter add crop on guest layer
- Perspective match: rotate guest via filter add rotate or Pillow pre-pass
- Lighting match: Pillow pre-pass for curves/color temp
- Inset frame: honest hard edge when no mask available

════════════════════════════════════════
TYPE (techniques-type.md)
════════════════════════════════════════
- Full-canvas overlay layer for all type: layer new --type image --fill transparent
- draw text: draw text --layer 0 --text "LINE" --x X --y Y --size S --color "#HEX" [--font TTF_PATH]
- Manual line breaks: no auto-wrap; break lines in script
- Leading: y += int(size * 1.2) between lines
- Font resolution: scripts/ensure_fonts.py → ~/.local/share/fonts/image-compose/
- Impact TTF for viral/meme/ragebait (NOT Anton)
- Anton for condensed gothic look only when explicitly asked
- Archivo Black, Bangers available in font dir
- Type contrast: draw rect band behind text (busy photo + light type = fail)
- Known-good palette: gold #f4d27a, paper #f6f1e8, mute #d7dde8, credit #9aa4b2 on #0b1220
- Size hierarchy: kicker 16-22px, headline 40-72px, deck 18-26px, credit 12-16px (on 1080-1600w)
- Fake stroke: darker draw rect slab behind text OR second text draw offset 2px (prefer slab)
- No tracking, no leading, no paragraph box in harness

════════════════════════════════════════
VIRAL (techniques-viral.md)
════════════════════════════════════════
- Urgency bar: draw rect top/bottom 64-96px, #c1121f or #0b3d91
- BREAKING/LIVE/NEWS word: draw text 20-28px white on urgency bar
- Impact headline: draw text 36-64px Impact, lines wrapped manually
- Lower-third ticker: draw rect + draw text 28px strip
- Hero full-bleed behind all overlay
- Circle inset (photo2): Pillow pillow_grade() circle_inset {d, cx, cy, ring, ring_color}
- Warhol-glitch composite: posterize + RGB offset + yellow strip + magenta ring
- bottom_lift: Pillow black gradient from lift_start (0.36-0.45) masking lower portion
- Double-draw for contrast: 4-6px black offset draw, then colored draw (NOT solid slab)
- --set l1=... --set l2=... overrides recipe copy slots
- Named person still: image search / news scrape, NOT Commons

════════════════════════════════════════
GRIDS (techniques-grids.md)
════════════════════════════════════════
- Swiss/ITS grid: modular columns, sans type, flush-left rag-right, no decoration
- Rule of thirds: 3x3 grid; subject on line or cross at x_in_{W/3,2W/3}, y_in_{H/3,2H/3}
- Magazine columns: 2-4 plus baseline grid, columns may merge
- Baseline snap: arithmetic in compose script (y values snap to 8 or 12px steps)
- Photo placement: crop via offset_x / offset_y + pre-resize
- No snap-to-guide, no visible guide export
- Canvas margins: typical 48px on 1080-wide

════════════════════════════════════════
COVERS (techniques-covers.md)
════════════════════════════════════════
- Magazine: masthead + date + hero + primary cover line + secondary lines + barcode corner
- Book: title > author, must read at 80px thumbnail, safe box for badges
- Album: square 1:1 (1080x1080) or 3000x3000 digital store
- Movie poster: credit block (dense small caps stack) + tagline + key art
- Canvas map: magazine 1080x1350 or 1600x2000, book 1600x2560, album 1080x1080 or 3000x3000, movie 1600x2400
- Credit block: many draw text lines, y += 18
- Copyright: new work only; do not lift existing jackets/one-sheets

════════════════════════════════════════
THUMBS (techniques-thumbs.md)
════════════════════════════════════════
- YouTube thumbnail: 1280x720 canvas
- Face + 2-4 words beats landscape alone
- High contrast, cut midtones, tight crop
- Eyes on upper third: offset_y placement
- Type 72-96px, one color + dark rect behind
- Fake stroke: dark rect slab under text (harness has no text stroke)
- Title on still != video title (different jobs)

════════════════════════════════════════
PRINT (techniques-print.md)
════════════════════════════════════════
- Bleed: 0.125 in (3 mm) extra image past trim → add 38px/side at 300dpi
- Trim: where blade aims; type stays inside safe zone
- Safe margin: 0.125 in inside trim for type protection
- Canvas = trim + 2xbleed in pixels at named DPI
- Photo runs to canvas edge (that's the bleed)
- No bleed box in harness; enforced by arithmetic
- Hardcover wraps need ~0.8 in (ask printer)

═════════════════════════════════════════
MASKS (techniques-masks.md) - mostly absent
════════════════════════════════════════
- Pre-cut alpha in Pillow: RGBA PNG, white=keep → layer add-from-file
- Hard crop: filter add crop on layer
- Hide under panel: draw rect on overlay
- Whole-layer opacity: layer set N opacity F
- Screen/multiply plate trick: black-bg highlight on screen = no-mask workaround
- NO layer masks, NO clipping masks, NO luminosity masks, NO paint-on-mask
- Alpha respected in _composite_layer if source PNG has it
style_schema_union:
STYLE JSON SCHEMA UNION (13 top-level fields, all 71 files)

TOP-LEVEL KEYS:
  id          (str)    -- unique style identifier, e.g. "instagram-ragebait-warhol-glitch"
e  family      (str)    -- one of: cover, editorial, photo, type, viral
  title       (str)    - human-readeable description, e.g. "Ragebait + Warhol flats + glitch offset"
  canvas      (union)  -- [W, H] int pair OR {"choices": [[W1,H1], [W2,HH2], ...]}
  background  (str)    -- hex color, e.g. "#0b1220", "#000", "#111111"
  font        (str)    -- font family name resolved by ensure_fonts.py, e.g. "Impact"
  photo       (dict)   -- photo placement spec:
    offset_x     (int|range-dict)  -- x offset in px or {"range": [lo, hi]}
    offset_y     (int|range-dict)  -- y offset in px or {"range": [lo, hi]}
    offset_jitter ([int,int])      -- random crop jitter [x_jitter, y_jitter]
    blend        (str|choices)     -- blend mode, e.g. "multiply" or {"choices": ["screen","overlay"]}
    opacity      (float|range)     -- layer opacity 0.0-1.0 or {"range": [lo, hi]}
  filters     (list)   -- array of filter objects, each:
    name         (str)    -- filter command name (posterize, contrast, saturation, etc.)
    param        (dict)   -- parameter map, values can be:
      factor       (float|range-dict) -- {"range": [lo, hi]}
      bits         (int|choices-dict) -- 2 or {"choices": [2,3,4]}
      radius       (int|range-dict)   -- {"range": [1, 3]}
      angle        (range-dict)       -- {"range": [-12, 12]}
      percent      (int)              -- 180
      strength     (float)            -- 0.7, 1.0
      threshold    (int|range-dict)   -- 2 or {"range": [80, 180]}
  pillow      (dict)   -- pre-export Pillow ops (harness cannot do these):
    contrast     (float) -- ImageEnhance.Contrast multiplier
    color        (float) -- ImageEnhance.Color multiplier
    bottom_lift  (bool)  -- enable black gradient mask from lift_start
    lift_start   (float) -- fraction of height where gradient begins (e.g. 0.40)
    circle_inset (dict)  -- circular photo2 inset:
      d            (float) -- diameter as fraction of min(W,H)
      cx           (float) -- center x as fraction of W
      cy           (float) -- center y as fraction of H
      ring         (int)   -- ring thickness in px
      ring_color   (str)   -- hex color of ring
  copy        (dict)   -- text slot definitions, keys are slot names:
    Values are string arrays (choices) for non-deterministic sampling.
    Keys used across 71 files:
      act, attr, author, bot, bug, cap, code, credits, deck, flag, frame,
      h1, h2, h3, handle, head, kicker, l1, l2, l3, label, left, masthead,
      name, no, num, pill, quote, right, stat, sub, tag, ticker, title,
      top, url, viewers, when, word, yes
  rects       (list)   -- array of rectangle draw ops:
    x1, y1, x2, y2  (int|str|range-dict) -- coords; strings eval'd with W,H,int,float,min,max
    fill             (str|choices-dict)   -- hex color or {"choices": [...]}
  texts       (list)   -- array of text draw ops:
    text   (str|choices-dict) -- literal or "{slot}" template filled from copy
    x, y   (int|str|range-dict) -- coords; strings eval'd with W,H,int,float,min,max
    size   (int|range-dict|choices-dict) -- font size
    color  (str|choices-dict) -- hex color
  brand       (str)    -- optional brand lock id or path to compact JSON, e.g. "retardglobal"

VALUE SEMANTICS:
  Scalar: literal value (int, float, str)
  {"range": [lo, hi]}: uniform sample from [lo, hi]; int range->randint, float->uniform
  {"choices": [a, b, ...]}: random choice from list
  String with {W,H,int,float,min,max}: eval'd as expression at render time

CANVAS SIZES USED (distinct):
  1080x1080, 1080x1350, 1080x1440, 1080x1920, 1280x720, 1600x900,
  1600x1000, 1600x1100, 1600x1200, 1600x2000, 1600x2400, 1600x2560,
  1920x800, 1920x1080, 3000x3000
  + 4 styles use {"choices": [...]} with multiple size options

families:
STYLE FAMILIES (5 distinct):
  cover      -- magazine/book/album/movie covers
  editorial  -- magazine layouts, Swiss grids, masthead designs
  photo      -- photography treatments, duotone, film looks
  type       -- typography-only posters, big type, minimal
  viral      -- ragebait, breaking news, ticker, IG memes, Warhol glitch
limitations:
HARNESS LIMITATIONS (must be respected, from harness-limits.md + INDEX.md):

  1. draw text does NOT wrap. Break lines manually in the script.
  2. Guesed Commons hash 404s. Use action=query&prop=imageinfo API.
  3. Draw ops are LAYER-LOCAL. Text at x=800 on a 480px photo layer vanishes.
     Always draw type on a full-canvas overlay layer.
  4. gimp -i -b / gimp-console hung (exit 124 in 20s). Stay on Pillow when
     draw_ops exist. Expect method=pillow.
  5. session undo is RAM-only (Session._undo_stack). One-shot CLI after compose:
     "Nothing to undo." Same-process/REPL undo works. save_session writes project JSON,
     not undo list.
  6. Negatie offsets work and will clip the layer.
  7. NO layer masks, clipping masks, luminosity masks. Work around with Pillow
     alpha pre-cut or hard crop or rect panel.
  8. NO Curves / Leels / Color Balance / HSL pickers. Use Pillow pre-pass for
     curves, color temperature, vignette.
  9. NO gradient tool. Fake gradients with stacked rects + opacity.
  10. NO warp, liquify, content-aware fill.
  11. Fonts: pass an absolute TTF path. The runner (run_style.py) resoles names
      like "Impact" to fonts in ~/.local/share/fonts/image-compose/. Anton is NOT Impact.
  12. NO auto text wrap.
  13. NO persistent undo across processes.
  14. NO stroke on text. Fake with darker draw rect slab behind text.
  15. NO snap-to-guide or isible guide export for grids.
  16. NO bleed box in harness. Enforce bleed/safe via arithmetic on canvas dimensions.
  17. NO tracking, leading, or paragraph box for text.
  18. NO per-channel blend or "blend if" sliders.
determinism_notes:
NON-DETERMINISTIC RUNNER (run_style.py) -- what a deterministic replacement needs:

  run_style.py is a NON-DETERMINISTIC style sampler:
  1. Random copy selection: each copy slot is a list of choices; runner picks one randomly.
     Deterministic replacement must accept explicit alues for eery slot.
  2. Range sampling: numeric fields with {"range": [lo, hi]} sample uniformly from the range
     (int->randint, float->uniform). Deterministic ersion needs fixed alues.
  3. Choices resolution: {"chocies": [...]} picks one at random. Deterministic ersion
     needs explicit selection (first, last, or named).
  4. Canvas: styles with {"chocies": [[W1,H1],[W2,H2]]} pick one at random. Deterministic
     replacement must accept explicit canvas or pin to first/specified choice.
  5. Photo jitter: offset_jitter [jx, jy] adds random crop offset +/-jx, +/-jy on fit_coer.
     Deterministic ersion needs jitter=0 or fixed offsets.
  6. Expression ealuation: strings like "int(W*0.08)" and "int(H*0.52)" are eal'd at
     runtime. These ARE deterministic gien W,H -- no change needed for these.
  7. Slot interpolation: "{handle}", "{l1}" templates are fille from sampled copy slots.
     Deterministic ersion still needs this; only the sampling side changes.
  8. --seed flag: when proided, makes the random.Random instance reproducible.
     Runner's result includes "seed_note": "non-deterministic unless --seed is set".
     A deterministic ersion would accept --seed but also accept explicit oerrides
     for eery sampled field.

  To make deterministic:
  - Accept explicit alues for all copy slots (--set already does this partly)
  - Accept fixed numeric alues for all range fields (or use midpoint/mean)
  - Accept fixed canvas dimensions (not choices)
  - Set offset_jitter to [0, 0] or accept explicit offsets
  - Pin choices to first item or accept explicit index
  - The --seed path already produces reproducible output IF seed is set,
    but the seed controls randomness, not explicit intent.
